contract_name: TCDX Unified Compliance Control Catalog canonical import contract
rules: Do not add or alter physical schema to fit this catalog.
Do not import full ISO normative text unless a licensed source is supplied by TCDX.
NormativeUnit is editorial structure; Requirement is atomic evaluable obligation; Control is operational/reference mechanism.
Annex A catalog controls are Control/ControlVersion regulatory_reference, not Requirement.
TCDX baseline controls are PLATFORM_CONTROL, tenant_id NULL, control_origin tcdx_baseline.
Tenant controls must be instantiated through canonical flows and based_on_control_version_id; do not duplicate global controls by seed.
UUIDs are UUIDv7 created by the importer. No UUID is stored in this catalog. Upsert/identity uses business keys.
Published history is immutable. Future licensed reconciliation creates governed versions/mappings; it does not rewrite prior published identities.
Crosswalks are typed. Do not create generic object_type/object_id relations.
QA/development use of provisional ISO summaries is allowed; official compliance/readiness use is blocked until licensing and review gates pass.
Preserve all 211 source candidate IDs and 104 independent proposals; no declaration of315 verified obligations.
Ten Law21.663 candidates retained; six crosswalks remain preliminary until homologation.
Raw candidates are manifest/source artifacts until true canonical identity/source/provenance can be assigned; do not fabricate source-origin, authorized/licensed flags or business UUIDs.
Test publication uses existing NON_AUTHORITATIVE_TEST_PACK, validation provenance/access and contextual rights; official pack gates remain independent.
The new scope is an amendment of the import contract, not a new 49-file catalogue or permission to run the v1.1 importer on incoming ZIPs.
fail_closed_conditions: unknown TCDX baseline control in RequirementControlMapping
attempt to mark ISO content official/licensed without licensed source manifest

source_origin_delta.necessity: Regulatory SourceOrigin currently has only licensed_file and official_source; neither truthfully represents a received preliminary preparation/review ZIP. Supporting source roles describe purpose, not acquisition origin. No reinterpretation of either existing origin is allowed.
source_origin_delta.representation: Import input/provenance artifact only, included in canonical import checksum; no new physical column, table, or authority class
source_origin_delta.rights: Receipt is not a license. Preserve actual rights per act and source; unknown rights deny protected reproduction only. licenseClassification describes non-authoritative use, not a grant of rights.
source_origin_delta.source_locator: Immutable received artifact/member locator with SHA256 and edition, via existing governance.provenance and object provenanceRef. officialUri identifies the authentic external reference when known; it never claims the received ZIP is official. Missing authentic source identity keeps raw candidates outside canonical import.
source_origin_delta.promotion: No in-place origin/authority promotion. Later authentic source creates governed source/version and explicit reviewed mappings; no historical rewrite.

law_21663_compatibility.authorized_source: Authentic Chilean legal source with exact edition/disposition citations and source checksum; verify publisher/URI/source against that artifact before official publication
law_21663_compatibility.temporal: Per authentic edition/disposition and transition conditions. Never reuse the fixed CL_LEY_21719 principal effective date or invent a uniform date. Unresolved temporal metadata blocks the affected canonical import, not independent package work.
law_21663_compatibility.existing_21719: Preserve existing official source, date and historical versions literally. No reclassification of its published official source as test content.
law_21663_compatibility.adapter_delta: Dispatch both law codes by their published source contracts. Only ISO codes require sourceType=standard. Extend allowlists and governed input validation without executing the historical v1.1 catalogue importer on these ZIPs.
law_21663_compatibility.approval: Official gate retains Regulatory Content Steward, Compliance Manager, GRC Manager and the legal/security review applicable to the authentic law source; source coverage and operational SoD are not waived by development authorization.

provisional_execution_boundary.review: Preserve reviewed=false/pending candidates and real review outcomes; receipt or shape validation does not approve them.
provisional_execution_boundary.access: Existing RegulatoryPackValidationAccess, validation provenance and demo/test tenant classifications, development/test/qa only; no production official use. No access rows or grants created by this contract.
provisional_execution_boundary.identities: 211 candidates, 104 independent proposals and six preliminary crosswalks remain source populations, not homologated canonical obligations.
provisional_execution_boundary.rights_provenance: Preserve original ZIP SHA, member locator/row ID/hash, publisher as actually declared, edition, reception/source provenance and actual rights evidence separately from review and official publication.
provisional_execution_boundary.gates: Each package source/edition/coverage/review/official gate is independent; unavailable rights for one protected body do not block unrelated metadata, original editorial or permitted internal tests.
